goal: Prevent Tor peers from inheriting permissions assigned to the local Tor daemon IP due to misclassification
Require a dedicated, non-wildcard onion bind and reject startup when automatic Tor listening lacks one
agreement: Substantive support with all objections resolved (vasild)
Concept or approach approval without stated reasons (jeanpablojp, winterrdog)
Contended that requiring specific IPs hurts containers with dynamic IPs, but addressed (schildbach)
Support noting extra container options are overkill since Docker can set specific IPs (vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an issue where Tor peers arriving on shared binds inherit local IP whitelist permissions
Ensures incoming Tor connections are properly distinguished from direct clearnet peers
